Record ID first per vendor doc. "Company name" (lower-case n) and "Company Domain Name" are HubSpot default company property labels from memory. HubSpot has no standard org number property; Swedish portals add a custom property, here labelled "Organisationsnummer" (custom label, invented by the portal owner). Domain without scheme in "Company Domain Name", full URL in "Website URL".
